data.body_html:
Planning an Estepona boat charter in June 2039? You’re in for perfect Mediterranean weather: average highs of 26°C, sea temperatures of 22°C, and gentle 8-knot winds. With 13.5 hours of daylight and sunset after 21:30, June offers the longest, most comfortable days for cruising from Puerto Banús to Estepona’s quiet coves. This guide gives you the weather data, sea conditions, and insider tips you need to book with confidence.

Estepona June 2039 Weather: What to Expect

June is the start of high summer on the Costa del Sol. Expect clear blue skies, zero rain on 95% of days, and a gentle sea breeze. The average temperature peaks at 26°C, with lows of 18°C after dark. Humidity is low (60%), making it feel fresher than inland. The sun is strong – UV index hits 9, so bring protection. Winds are typically 6–10 knots from the southwest, ideal for smooth motoring on any of our boats.

Sea Conditions & Swell for June Charters

The Mediterranean off Estepona in June is unusually calm. Swell averages 0.5–1.2m with a long period, meaning minimal rocking. The Strait of Gibraltar can push a light chop, but our skippers choose protected routes. For the smoothest ride, book a Tier B boat like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) which slices through any ripple. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offers elevated views and stability.

Best Boats for Estepona in June

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes from Estepona. For small groups, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) is fun for a quick dash to Cala del Faro. For families, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at €749/2h includes skipper, fuel, and drinks. Want luxury? The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers a flybridge and spacious saloon. All charters include insurance, safety gear, and Spanish VAT.

Sunset Cruises: The June Highlight

With sunset at 21:35, an evening charter from 19:00–21:00 is magical. The light paints La Concha mountain gold. Our Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749/2h is perfect for a romantic trip. Sip cava as you cruise past the Golden Mile. Book a sunset slot early – they sell out by mid-June.

Anchoring & Swimming Spots Near Estepona

June’s warm water (22°C) makes swimming a must. Top spots include Cala Cortés and Cala del Faro, both sheltered with sandy beaches. The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) can nudge close to shore. Our skippers know the quietest anchorages away from crowds. All boats have a swim ladder and fresh-water shower.

What to Pack for a June Boat Charter

  • SPF 50+ sunscreen (reapply every 2 hours)
  • Hat, sunglasses, and a light windbreaker
  • Swimwear and a towel (we provide towels on request)
  • Camera or phone for sunset shots
  • Light jacket for the return trip after sunset

We provide unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No need to bring food or drink – just yourself.

Booking Tips for June 2039

June is peak season. Book 4–6 weeks ahead via WhatsApp for the best availability. The Mangusta 80 (white) and K80 (24m) are popular for groups of 12. For a bargain, the Azimut 39 at €749/2h is great value. If you need a jet ski, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes one free. Contact us for pricing on other boats – we respond within 15 minutes.
